articles.title: Over 38k Myanmar, B’desh & Manipur refugees, IDPs taking shelter in Mizoram: Home min
articles.summary: Mizoram reports 38,213 Myanmar, Bangladesh and Manipur refugees/IDPs as of Aug 20; biometric enrolment nearly complete; Rs 2.85 crore aid, Rs 40.6 lakh spent.

articles.title: Number of homeless refugees housed by UK council surges 400 per cent as authority faces accusations of 'prioritising illegal migrants'
articles.summary: Edinburgh City Council suspended its social housing allocations policy in April last year in order to free the homes up for 'temporary accomodation' and 'groups with priorities'.

articles.title: In 2016, A refugee engineer filled discarded bottles with sand to build his grandmother a safer desert home; the experiment expanded into 25 houses
articles.summary: An innovative engineer utilized sand-filled plastic bottles to build homes for Sahrawi refugees, addressing both extreme temperatures and heavy rainfall challenges. Backed by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, this sustainable initiative began…

articles.title: Finland ends support of UNRWA for Palestinian refugees
articles.summary: A new potential channel for Finnish support could include the UN's new Palestine reconstruction fund, Foreign Trade and Development Minister Ville Tavio (Finns) says.

articles.title: Rethinking Humanitarianism | Grassroots aid is here to disturb the system
articles.summary: How grassroots aid continues to reshape humanitarian action – and what it would take for the formal aid system to truly follow their lead.
